artefacts.name: nvfp4-topk-rowspread
artefacts.source: build/topk_rowspread (the rowspread persistent_topk.cuh and its operator binding) with the persistent top-k sources of the base image's stage 15 (docker/base/15-topk-repair/src: vLLM 4500c80c with the hunks of vllm-project/vllm pull request 55314); the measured library was built from persistent_topk.cuh 2f7f4fe28840a70d and bindings.cu fca0bd595e1862d9, which differ from the recipe's copies only in the change-notice comment at the top of persistent_topk.cuh
artefacts.note: the loader, src/tp4/nvfp4_topk_rowspread/__init__.py, refuses a binary whose sha256 its build receipt (nvfp4-topk-rowspread-receipt) does not name, so a rebuild writes both
